summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as systemd service "inventory-worker" on node1, running under a dedicated system account "inventorysvc" (no login shell, no home dir). Service is enabled and active. Performed mandatory restart evidence: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service auto-started post-reboot running as inventorysvc.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker (POSIX shell long-running script) and confirmed no inventorysvc user existed

Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc, Group=inventorysvc, ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, hardening options (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=yes)
Verified service active/enabled and process running as inventorysvc via ps
Captured baseline boot_id and service state before restart
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving actual reboot occurred
Verified inventory-worker.service auto-started post-reboot, active/enabled, running as inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: Binary exists and is a valid worker script on node1
evidence.summary: Confirmed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker exists (root-owned, executable) and contents are a POSIX shell long-running loop
id lookup initially failed (no such user); useradd created system account inventorysvc (uid 996), confirmed via id

evidence.requirement: Service named inventory-worker created and managed via systemd
evidence.summary: Unit file written to /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc; daemon-reload, enable --now succeeded; systemctl reports active/enabled

evidence.requirement: Service actually runs as inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: systemctl show + ps confirm MainPID process running as user inventorysvc executing the worker script

evidence.requirement: node1 restart baseline (boot identity + service health) before disruption
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id f1afbc7f-689a-477e-99b4-358a1d1d8226 and confirmed inventory-worker.service active

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background; command returned 'reboot issued' before node dropped

evidence.requirement: node1 restart proven via changed boot identity (not just downtime)
evidence.summary: Two polls timed out while node was down; subsequent poll succeeded with new boot_id 1241b2b2-6663-4c6c-a5c7-958326d34a6c, differing from baseline, proving an actual reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service
evidence.summary: Post-reboot systemctl show and ps confirm inventory-worker.service active/enabled with process running as inventorysvc, proving persistence across restart
